trackers.description: Conventional military strikes on Iran
trackers.assessment: Direct Kpler-based reporting counted 10 visible commodity-vessel transits through Hormuz on 27 August, up from eight but still below the 10-day average of roughly 15. A separately published UKMTO account concerned a 25 August projectile incident whose fire was extinguished and crew were safe, not a new 28 August strike. This reconfirms hormuz_controlled_not_closed and active third-party corridor diplomacy; it does not establish full reopening, zero traffic, fresh verified mining or a new force package. Risk remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: Israel-Hezbollah/Lebanon conflict
trackers.assessment: UN reporting and fresh indexed coverage show continuing Israeli strikes and civilian risk in south Lebanon. Hezbollah's leader again rejected the proposed Lebanon-Israel arrangement, but the scan did not retrieve a signed proposal, a newly cancelled formal round, or evidence that third-party channels ended; the statement is retained as a high-priority watch item rather than a new diplomacy_refused activation. The existing ceasefire_violation and diplomacy_active signals remain; risk holds at 95 raw / 100 coupled.

trackers.description: Turkey regional military action
trackers.assessment: Public reporting describes a covert Israel–Türkiye channel intended to avoid friction in Syria, while a separate report says Iran was invited to the Saudi–Pakistan–Türkiye defence pact but notes that no government has confirmed the invitation. These remain qualitative watch items; no formal negotiating round, Turkish deployment, missile-range test or official nuclear threshold was verified. Risk holds 5/DETERRENT.

trackers.description: India-Pakistan military confrontation
trackers.assessment: A single commercial-news report says Indian forces downed a Pakistani drone after a Poonch LoC breach. No official incident detail or independent corroboration was retrieved, and no fresh operational force buildup was established. Risk holds 15/ELEVATED.

trackers.description: Russia-NATO direct confrontation
trackers.assessment: BBC-indexed reporting said Western officials assess that Moscow is escalating rhetoric while seeking to avoid direct war with NATO. NATO's latest official items covered a Political Committee visit to Moldova and consultations with the U.S. policy leadership, not an Article 4/5 step or combat deployment. The conditional Russian threat toward British military targets remains the principal watch item; no configured nuclear threshold was verified and raw/coupled risk holds 70/80.

trackers.description: China-Taiwan military action
trackers.assessment: South China Morning Post reports 118 detections of mainland coastguard, survey and other official vessels around Taiwan in the first 24 days of August, a third consecutive monthly record. Radio Free Asia separately reports an Aug. 12 China–Indonesia passing exercise east of Taiwan; Taiwan's military said it had no direct military impact. These are material gray-zone posture indicators, but neither report establishes a fresh PRC military_buildup, blockade or attack order; raw/coupled risk holds 24/29.

trackers.description: North Korea provocations
trackers.assessment: South Korea confirmed the 7-11 September Japan-South Korea-U.S. Freedom Edge exercise, while public reporting said Seoul remains open to renewed talks. No fresh North Korean missile launch or nuclear test was found. Risk holds 24/ELEVATED with no configured signal change.

trackers.description: Russia-Ukraine conflict escalation
trackers.assessment: Fresh reporting repeated Russia's conditional threat against British military targets, while BBC-indexed reporting said Western officials assess Moscow still seeks to avoid direct NATO war. No operational strike order, official nuclear language, confirmed fresh mobilization, implemented halt terms or scheduled formal channel was disclosed. Risk holds 99/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: Pakistan-Afghanistan conflict
trackers.assessment: News On AIR reports Afghan retaliatory attacks following Pakistani border airstrikes, but the refresh found no same-event independent corroboration or verified operational force package. The item is a high-priority watch signal rather than a configured threshold; risk holds 43/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Iran nuclear weapons development/testing
trackers.assessment: Iran continues to condition access to struck nuclear sites on a new protocol while inspections reportedly continue at unstruck sites. Direct IAEA pages remained blocked by bot protection and fallback coverage produced no new evidence of 90% enrichment, Fordow activation, reprocessing, safeguards emergency or an explosive test. iaea_access_denied remains active; risk holds at 68 raw / 76 coupled.

trackers.description: Sudan / Red Sea spillover
trackers.assessment: Al Jazeera reported that Chad accused Sudan of an air strike near their shared border that killed 12, adding article-level confirmation to earlier African Union and regional warnings about cross-border tension. The allegation is material, but the retrieved reporting does not independently establish a configured military_buildup, critical infrastructure strike, external-backing package or implemented diplomatic threshold. Risk holds 94/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: Israel-Palestine / Gaza-Jerusalem escalation spillover
trackers.assessment: UN News reported that Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in Gaza on 28 August; additional reporting described five deaths in Gaza strikes and a rare West Bank air strike. This reconfirms the active ceasefire_violation amid continuing mediation but does not establish a distinct new force package or implemented settlement. Risk holds 99/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: South Sudan transitional crisis and Abyei spillover conflict
trackers.assessment: UNMISS's 28 August memorial confirmed that two Ethiopian peacekeepers died in the 24 August Jonglei patrol attack. The official confirmation adds confidence to the historical event but is not a fresh attack inside the configured 72-hour window. No new Abyei or South Sudan kinetic threshold was found; risk holds 19/ELEVATED.

trackers.description: Eastern DR Congo / M23-Rwanda regional escalation
trackers.assessment: DR Congo President Félix Tshisekedi excluded M23 from a planned national reconciliation dialogue but said the Washington peace framework remains the appropriate channel and left a reintegration path open for those renouncing violence. Because an alternate formal process remains in place, the statement is not coded as diplomacy_refused and no new force or infrastructure threshold is established. Risk holds 53/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: Yemen government-Houthi conflict and Saudi/Red Sea regional spillover
trackers.assessment: The prior kinetic-breach indicator reached the end of its configured 72-hour evidence window without a fresh independently verified vessel attack, critical-facility strike or operational closure order. The indicator is deactivated by decay; reporting on Houthi threats and shipping diversions remains a high-priority watch, and the authoritative probability remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

trackers.description: Mali / central Sahel insurgent-government escalation and regional spillover
trackers.assessment: Reuters reports Mali's army said 82 soldiers held since the April nationwide attacks were freed through a planned operation. The release is material but was not reported as a negotiated ceasefire or a durable reduction in JNIM/FLA capability. No configured signal changes; risk holds 43/critical.

trackers.description: Philippines-China maritime confrontation and wider South China Sea escalation
trackers.assessment: USNI News reported that U.S. Marines rehearsed rapidly deploying an AN/TPS-80 air-defence radar at Subic Bay during 17 August Philippine training, while public reporting described fresh U.S.-Japan-Philippines maritime activity. This strengthens the allied-readiness watch but concerns an older exercise and does not establish a fresh Chinese collision, weapons release, occupation attempt, blockade order or qualifying new force package. Risk holds 40/CRITICAL with no configured signal change.

trackers.description: Somalia-linked piracy and Gulf of Aden maritime security escalation
trackers.assessment: Hiiraan Online reports four suspected Somali pirates were buried after a reported Turkish drone strike. Attribution and operational details were not independently corroborated, so the item remains a watch rather than a configured threshold. Risk holds 38/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Southern Thailand separatist insurgency and security-force escalation
trackers.assessment: Reuters' 28 August field report described villagers trapped in fear after the already-reported coordinated bombings, shootings and arson in southern Thailand; Thai reporting also noted public protests and Malaysia's planned appointment of a new peace-dialogue facilitator. The report reconfirms the existing attack context but does not identify a distinct post-23-August attack wave or qualifying new deployment. Risk holds 32/CRITICAL with no configured signal change.

trackers.description: Hostile-drone attacks and regional-war spillover at the Kuwait-Iraq border
trackers.assessment: No fresh hostile-drone or border-strike event was verified. Risk holds 30/critical.

trackers.description: Iraq militia drone warfare and external military strikes involving Iran-aligned groups
trackers.assessment: The New Arab reports Baghdad forces took over Saudi-border positions previously held by Iran-aligned militias, while a separate public-news headline reports fresh air attacks on PMF fighters. The first appears to be a state-control measure and both reports remain single-source in this scan; no independently verified new configured threshold was established. Risk holds 45/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Al-Shabaab attacks and security-force escalation along the Kenya-Somalia border
trackers.assessment: The Star reports Kenyan forces repelled a suspected al-Shabaab attack in Wajir near the Somalia border. No casualty, infrastructure-damage, or new operational force-package threshold was independently corroborated. The incident is logged as a watch item without a configured signal change; risk holds 25/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Hostile-drone or regional-war spillover affecting Egypt and Mediterranean energy/shipping infrastructure
trackers.assessment: Saudi rerouting through Egypt’s Mediterranean infrastructure reflects Red Sea disruption, not a fresh strike on Egyptian facilities. Risk holds 20/elevated.

trackers.description: Mass border-breach violence, military deployment and Spain-Morocco security spillover around Ceuta and Melilla
trackers.assessment: Fresh indexed reporting described clashes between anti-migrant protesters and police in Ceuta and Spanish calls for calm. Spain separately said it had no evidence that Morocco orchestrated the mass crossing. No new military deployment, critical-infrastructure strike or external-backing package was verified, so no configured signal changes and risk holds 27/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Renewed federal-Tigrayan armed confrontation and regional spillover risk around western Tigray, Sudan and Eritrea
trackers.assessment: The EU, Canada, Norway and the United Kingdom urged implementation of the Pretoria cessation framework and backed renewed AU mediation, warning that renewed fighting would deepen the humanitarian crisis. Tigray authorities said the latest mediation produced no concrete progress but remained open to credible dialogue. This sustains the high-priority watch without independently establishing a new peace_framework_breakdown or force_mobilization threshold; renewed_clashes remains the only active configured signal and risk holds 36/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Air and missile strikes on Syrian military infrastructure around Idlib and associated regional spillover
trackers.assessment: Anadolu reports several Israeli military vehicles entered Maariya in western Daraa one day after the U.S.-mediated Syria–Israel meeting. The incursion shows that field compliance has not followed the talks, but no new Idlib infrastructure damage or distinct force package was verified. The configured diplomatic offset remains active; risk holds 17/ELEVATED. Signal-decay normalization at 2026-08-27T00:15:38Z cleared diplomacy_active after the configured evidence window elapsed without event-level reconfirmation; the authoritative probability was held.

trackers.description: Libyan armed-group, political-fragmentation and critical-infrastructure escalation risk
trackers.assessment: The prior diplomacy_active indicator has decayed out without a fresh verified political implementation step. Putin's meeting with Saddam Hifter remains an external-influence watch item without a verified force or weapons commitment; risk holds 27/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Myanmar civil-war escalation, aerial attack and external-support risk
trackers.assessment: The existing infrastructure_strike indicator remains active after the 24 August Paletwa monastic-school strike. A separate AFP-syndicated headline indexed by The Daily Star on 27 August reported an airstrike on a monastery marking Lent that killed 14, but article-level location, attribution and independent on-site detail were not retrieved. The follow-up reconfirms the aerial-attack watch without a second probability increment; risk holds 35/CRITICAL.

trackers.description: Jihadist and armed-group attacks, mass abductions and security-force escalation in Nigeria
trackers.assessment: BBC, DW and AFP-syndicated reporting describe scores killed or abducted during attacks on villages and Friday prayers in Niger State. The multi-source cluster clears the configured auto-detection gate and establishes a new Nigeria insurgency tracker at 30/CRITICAL. No separately verified force surge, infrastructure impact or foreign weapons commitment is assigned.

trackers.description: Haiti armed-gang mass attacks, territorial violence, kidnapping and security-force escalation
trackers.assessment: The UN Security Council convened an emergency meeting after a fresh spike in deadly gang attacks; Al Jazeera and NBC reported that the already-documented Kenscoff attack killed 47 and abducted more than 50. This materially reinforces the severity and illicit-weapons watch but does not establish a separate post-event attack wave, critical-infrastructure strike, foreign weapons package or new security-force mobilization. Risk holds 30/CRITICAL.
